messages:
Anna M.: Hey team — kickstarting the playbook for the joint webinar + CloudX marketplace inbound routing. Need a quick ops plan.
Anna M.: High-level goals: 1) run webinar that drives qualified integration leads 2) ensure marketplace listing routes leads to partner SDRs correctly 3) publish a joint benchmark blog that supports the webinar narrative.
Mike P.: Partner asks for a 30m demo + 15m case/benchmarks. They’ll own invites to their customers and share an audience list.
Ravi S.: For inbound routing I propose HubSpot workflow: marketplace form -> contact create -> set source=cloudx_marketplace -> match domain -> assign to partner queue.
Ravi S.: Pseudocode for assignment logic:
```
if source == 'cloudx_marketplace' and domain in partner_domains:
  owner = partner_sdr_lookup(domain)
  add_to_list('CloudX Leads - Partner')
  set_deal_stage('Partner MQL')
```
Sophia D.: Marketing will own registration page + emails + webinar nurture. Need UTMs and an event campaign so we can report CPL/SQL. Suggested UTM string: 
```
?utm_source=cloudx&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=redwood_cloudx_webinar
```
Julia K.: Messaging notes — keep the headline benefits clear: predictable p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and quality (eval pass-rate). Benchmarks should be repeatable; include a brief methodology paragraph in the blog.
Anna M.: PMs / Eng — can someone supply benchmark numbers + short methodology blurb by Wed (3d)? We need that to finalize slide deck and blog.
Mike P.: I’ll pull partner perf numbers and get their legal sign-off by Tue EOD. They also want a co-branded CTA that routes to partner-assigned SDRs.
Ravi S.: On routing infra: recommend marketplace -> webhook -> our ingestion endpoint -> HubSpot create/contact enrich -> owner assignment. I’ll draft the webhook spec + example payload.
Anna M.: Assets checklist: 1) co-branded slide deck 2) 10-min demo script 3) benchmark appendix (data + method) 4) registration landing copy + form 5) nurture email sequence 6) joint blog draft 7) sandbox invite for partner customers.
Sophia D.: Marketing will do landing + emails + recording nurture + event ads. We should set funnel targets: registrants -> attendees -> MQL conversion % targets. Also want a short on-demand CTA on the landing page.
Julia K.: For the blog/benchmark narrative: recommend sections: context/problem, test harness, key metrics (p95, tokens/sec, cost/1k, eval pass rate), short customer quote, TL;DR takeaway. I’ll draft and circulate.
Anna M.: Can we also decide on lead SLA? Partner wants 24h follow-up for hot leads. Ravi — can HubSpot ownership + notification guarantee that?
Ravi S.: Yes — we can create a workflow that sends SMS + email to owner and creates a follow-up task. SLA field can be set on contact record.
Mike P.: Quick ask from partner: include a sandbox access token for demo-try in the nurture so their customers can validate claims. We can gate it behind a short form.
Sophia D.: Good call — we’ll add a gated sandbox sign-up step in the post-webinar nurture.
Anna M.: Timeline: draft assets due next Fri. Final deck + landing + automation done 3 days before webinar. Can everyone confirm?
Mike P.: Confirmed.
Ravi S.: Confirmed.
Sophia D.: Confirmed.
Julia K.: Confirmed.
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: Joint webinar ops sync — Thu 10:00am PT. Invite sent to participants.
Anna M.: I’ll post the Notion playbook and link to assets after the sync: https://notion.so/redwood/cloudx-webinar-playbook
Anna M.: Registration CTA draft: "See how to cut inference costs up to 40% while keeping p95 latency under X ms — live demo + verified benchmarks. Register now."
Mike P.: Partner also requested a short 1-pager for their sales team to explain routing and expected SLAs. I’ll own that.
Anna M.: Perfect. Thanks all — I’ll follow up with meeting notes and action items in this thread.
